extra_lines: tab "<title>" (version 7: the lines after it are a Settings tab of their own)
show <key> "<label>" [?key=value] [@mode,mode] (version 7: setting_show sets its text; hidden while "")

kinds.setting_get: the chosen index; the first is the default

kinds.setting_text: the password: never written to a file, forgotten when Settings closes, never @lobby (version 7)

mode_get: the chosen mode's id during game.new, "" for a plain new game (version 6)
mode_code: the world code typed in the Join box during game.new, "" for a new world (version 6)
